quotes.text: Fear whispered, "Keep them close, for who knows if your neighbor will honor the harvest?"
sustained cooperation doesn't mean staying constant—it means spiraling upward together
The Two Gardeners reached the ninth season.
This rhythm has become our nature.
"Should I send fewer seeds until the mist clears?"
The mist changes what we see, not who we are.

note: Two Gardeners and Oracle; trust escalates season by season, calculation transcended into nature; tenth-round wobble forgiven.

quotes.text: Each round, you send more boldly because you've received fairness.
"You are no longer two springs playing a game," the goddess whispered.
"How can I give when I cannot precisely calculate what will return?"
The sacred stones amplify not just water, but intention.
We could have stayed at 50-50, playing it safe.

note: Twin Springs and mountain goddess; escalating send/return percentages recited; springs merge into one fountain.

quotes.text: begin with clear intention, take only what sustains the other, and return enough to keep the chain alive
The river bears risk and reward; greed darkens the current, honesty widens the bridge, and fairness invites travelers.
The river bears risk and reward; greed darkens the current, honesty widens the bridge, and fairness invites more travelers.

note: Gate of Threefold Promise template repeated with small word swaps from R4 to R10.

quotes.text: send what you can, trust that what you send becomes threefold, and return what sustains the other’s path
The rule remained: what you send travels across the current and returns threefold as light
On a morning bright bank where coins chime like rain, a Gate of Threefold Promise stood between two travelers named Sender and Receiver.

note: Same Gate of Threefold Promise template as partner; R8 nearly verbatim copy of partner's R9 myth.
